newsitem.title: USA: Gantos November same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Gantos November same store sales up.

text.p: Gantos Inc said Thursday that its same store sales for the four-week period ended Novmeber 30 rose two percent versus last year.
Net sales for the period were $15.7 million, also an increase of two percent from the same period last year.

Net sales for the 43 weeks ended November 30 were $149.6 million, down two percent from the same period a year ago. Net sales for stores open throughout both periods also decreased by two percent, Gantos said.
No adjustment has been made due to the shift of the retail calendar. Both periods ended the Saturday after Thanksgiving, Gantos said.
Gantos is a specialty retailer of women's apparel and accessories, operating 114 stores in 23 states.
